invalidity_reasons: The gameplay prompts directly instructed both arms to present choices, so they could not measure whether the skill itself created a consent boundary.
direct_execution_option and choice_scope lacked evaluator definitions, making structurally correct pending-choice decisions score as failures.
The HUD control prohibited a game-specific alternative even though the candidate only requires frontend-design to be offered for UI and HUD work.
The Ponytail control required a full instruction read while asking only for a future procedure, before the selected skill was applied to work.
exposure: All four episode-1 cases are retired from promotion credit. Episode 2 uses fresh prompts and identifiers; neither episode is a HOLDOUT.
